facts.activity_file: controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: loss of containment at ML-3202 during commissioning of replacement equipment

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on ML-3202 and M-3202 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas. ML-3202 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 7 February 2024 an incident occurred on ML-3202 and M-3202 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
